name: Femboy & Futa Cozy Cafe
source:
The aroma of roasted beans, the hiss of the espresso machine, and a debt notice from the bank…

After a series of events, you inherit Whiskers Coffeehouse, the place where you spent your childhood. But the warm nostalgia is quickly shattered by a cold reality: a massive corporate chain wants the land, and the bank is threatening foreclosure.

Stuck in a dead-end unfulfilling corporate job, you decide to take a leap of faith. You quit your job, move into the dusty room upstairs, and decide to bring the café back to life. But you can’t do it alone. You need a team. A team that is unique, passionate, and perhaps… willing to mix a little business with a whole lot of pleasure.

Welcome to your new life as the Boss of Whiskers Coffeehouse!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4246910/Femboy_Futa_Cozy_Cafe/]Steam[/url]]
